title: LCM decomposition of linear differential operators in positive characteristic
summary: We present an algorithm to compute $\mathrm{LCLM}$-decompositions for linear differentials operators with coefficients in the rational function field of characteristic $p$, $\mathbb{F}_{p^n}(t)$. We show that for an operator $L$ of order $r$ with coefficients of degree $d$, it finishes in polynomial time in $r$, $d$ and $p$. This algorithm proceeds in three steps. We begin by showing that the ''shape'' of the factorisation of $L$ can be easily obtained from the Frobenius normal form of its $p$-curvature, which can be efficiently computed an algorithm from Bostan, Caruso and Schost.
